integrity: A direct structural proof, independently implemented exhaustive finite checks and self-review are included; no independent audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only full edge-subdivisions of complete graphs with n at least three. Novelty is assessed against inspected literature, not asserted as absolutely unique. Finite verification does not prove the infinite result.
title: Dissociation and maximal-dissociation enumerators of complete-graph subdivisions
